Sitting within our Treasury team, you'll work with the heads of our Stablecoin and Payment / Remittances initiatives, in-country teams and relationship managers to turn that flow into a consistently profitable book. Ensure that trading activity is within defined strategies, counterparty credit limits, operating limits and allocated working capital. Ensure that trade disputes are cleanly managed by Traders, stepping in where required. Ensure that Trade execution and Trade Settlements are per Standard Operating procedures. Ensure that accurate records of trades and P&L are kept. Manage P/L and risk Own the aggregate of desk's P&L and risk-adjusted P/L against targets and risk limits — you'll know your numbers cold and be able to defend every line of them. Manage the execution of trades to hedge Luno's market risk on its working capital and revenue streams, and execute revenue liquidation trades. Manage trading strategy Agree trading strategies across multiple desks relating to crypto and FX — for OTC, corporate hedging and revenue liquidation. Reporting responsibility Aggregate reporting at the Global level, for regular distribution to senior stakeholders on trading activity, performance and market insight. Motivate for changes in counterparty credit limits, operating limits and allocated working capital, where required to support sustainable profitability. Spec improvements to Luno's trading and risk systems and processes to shape our push into automation — helping us evolve from manual execution to a scaled, systematic operation. Pressure-test our risk frameworks and models, and make the case for changes as market dynamics shift. Relationship management Establish and nurture internal relationships with Cross functional teams across Luno (Marketing, Sales, Product, Compliance, Legal etc). Build durable relationships with desk clients alongside our traders, country teams and relationship managers — the goal is repeat flow, not one-off tickets. A little about you: 5–8 years of trading experience within a sell-side OTC desk, market maker, prop desk or brokerage in crypto (preferred), FX, equities or derivatives. 3-5 years of experience managing traders / trading teams within a sell-side OTC desk, market maker, prop desk or brokerage in crypto (preferred), FX, equities or derivatives. Your trading and trader management experience includes P/L responsibility based on Trade and Counter-trade within trade size limits, position limits, working capital etc (the Luno OTC desk acts as a principal rather than executing under customer instructions). Bachelor's in Finance, Economics, Mathematics, Business Administration, Accounting or related discipline. RE5 certificate would be preferable & advantageous Derivatives arbitrage knowledge or experience would be a plus. An advanced degree or professional qualification (CFA, CAIA, MBA) in a related field is beneficial. A successful broking / OTC trading track record across more than one market. Ability to adapt to a fast-paced and dynamic trading environment. Compliance with regulatory standards and a commitment to ethical trading practices. Strong attention to detail and accuracy in trade execution and documentation. Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, a strong team player. Friendly, transparent, articulate and driven to succeed. Life at Luno: Remote but reachable work policy gives you the freedom to choose between working from home or the office. Improve body and mind, with excellent private medical insurance Retirement fund benefit, helping you build the financial foundation you need to enjoy your future to the fullest. Access to Learnably and our additional learning platforms for your personal and professional development 6 months primary care-giver leave Paw-ternity leave for your furry friend Annual Inspiration Day in addition to your annual leave which increases based on your length of service! Plus the option to buy and sell up to 5 days leave A collaborative, friendly work community, with regular social events and virtual cooking, dancing, drawing and house planting classes hosted by our Lunauts Free lunch and snacks 0 fees up to a certain amount with Luno from the day you start.* Offer only available on Luno Instant Buy, not Luno Exchange.
